description:
Where every product is listed, by storefront, across all of the merchant's stores and (by default) all of their workspaces. One table: `storefronts` are the real shops (provider + shop) with every ApparelHub store connected to each and the shop's `admin_url`; `rows` are products ApparelHub made (`kind: product`, one row however many stores hold it) and the merchant's own channel listings (`kind: tracked`, one row per shop), each with created_at / updated_at / synced_at / listed_at, `ordered` + `last_ordered_at` (a yes/no from non-cancelled orders; counts and revenue are on the analytics tools) and `store_cells` (every store-by-storefront status); each `cells[<storefront key>]` gives the status there (listed / in_progress / failed / not_listed / draft / archived) and `managed_by`: `apparelhub` (ApparelHub made and syncs it) or `channel` (the merchant made it on the channel and manages it there; it is on sale but cannot be changed from ApparelHub). A missing cell means the product is in no store connected to that shop. Use this instead of composing stores x products x tracked listings yourself; it is the same data the merchant sees on their Where it's listed page. Rows are paged; `totals` and `storefronts` describe the whole filtered set, and `fulfillment_providers` lists the providers to narrow by. Narrow by time and provider to answer "what went live on TikTok Shop this week" (provider + listed_after) or "what did I sync with Printful before October" (fulfillment_provider + synced_before). Read-only.

[#fd22ad]

all_workspaces.description: Default true: every workspace you can reach. false = one workspace (see `workspace`).

filter.description: "nowhere" = listed on no storefront; "failed" = a failed sync somewhere; "external" = only the merchant's own channel listings; "ordered" = ordered at least once. Default all.

fulfillment_provider.description: Only products made with this fulfillment provider (a uuid from `fulfillment_providers` in the response), plus channel listings bound to one. An unknown uuid returns no rows.

group.description: "workspace": rows come back grouped by their first store's workspace, each carrying `workspace`.

listed_after.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Only rows that last went live on a sales channel on or after this UTC day. A row never listed matches neither bound.

listed_before.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Only rows that last went live on a sales channel on or before this UTC day (inclusive).

provider.description: Only storefronts on this sales channel, by name (e.g. "WooCommerce", "TikTok Shop").

sort.description: Row order. listed_at = last time it went live on a shop; synced_at = last sync to its fulfillment provider; last_ordered_at = latest non-cancelled order. Rows without the value come last either way. Default name.

store.description: Only this store uuid and the storefronts it is connected to.

synced_after.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Only rows synced with their fulfillment provider on or after this UTC day. A row never synced matches neither bound.

synced_before.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Only rows synced with their fulfillment provider on or before this UTC day (inclusive).

workspace.description: Workspace uuid. Only used with all_workspaces=false. Omit to see every workspace you can reach.

name: where_its_listed
title: Where every product is listed
